notes.zh-CN: 聊天顶栏「已工作」耗时旁与用量弹窗内新增词元输出速率（t/s）展示：流式阶段实时估算并排除工具调用、权限审批与限流等待时间，回合结束后按各 CLI 真实输出词元自动校准。macOS universal 为开发签名且未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Adds token output speed (t/s) beside the header turn clock and inside the usage popover: estimates live during streaming while excluding tool calls, permission waits, and rate-limit backoffs, then calibrates with exact CLI output tokens when the turn finishes. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
